NOT TO EXCEED $7,900,000, FOR THE
PURPOSE OF FINANCING STREET
IMPROVEMENTS AND TRANSPORTATION
PROJECTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED

IMPROVING:
10TH STREET BETWEEN HIGHWAY 85

A VOTER APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE
UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE
COLORADO CONSTITUTION AND ANY
OTHER REVENUE LIMITATIONS CONTAINED
IN THE LAWS OF THE STATE?

YEAR OF COLLECTION) AND BY SUCH

EACH YEAR THEREAFTER FOR THE SOLE
PURPOSE OF FUNDING THE FINANCING,

PROJECT INCLUDING A CITY HALL,
PUBLIC PLAZA, PARKING GARAGE

THE WEST GREELEY CATALYST
·
PROJECT, INCLUDING AN ARENA,
YOUTH ICE CENTER, WATER PARK,
HOTEL, AND RELATED

IMPROVEMENTS;

·

·
